notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.
